title: The full enlarged bar is the stage-bar colimit
statement: For the enlarged bar tower [def-sc-compact-flat-enlarged-bar-tower], the full bar of the entire enlarged index [def-sc-compact-flat-bar-index] with its stage inclusions is a colimit of F_n.

source.place: The source-bar, finite-cone-block, least-block adjunction and union-bar paragraphs; The full enlarged bar is the stage-bar colimit.

proof.text: A full-bar string has finitely many vertices, hence the maximum of their stage labels bounds them. A compatible cocone gives a map on that generator using the lifted string in this stage. The reindexing formula on term generators proves that every later stage gives the same map. Descend along the column coproducts and total diagonal coproduct. The same formula proves factorization and uniqueness. This is a colimit in each evaluated degree, so HomologicalComplex.isColimitOfEval gives a colimit of complexes. The colimit data is selected only from this proved universal property.
